x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given an HR case for a payroll service, When it is created, Then it is assigned to the payroll team by matching rule and an SLA attaches Given a Tier 1 agent cannot resolve a case, When they transfer it, Then the case moves to the Tier 2 COE with history intact
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: HR cases are routed to the correct HR team with tiered support and SLAs
